book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: On the fifth voyage, I bought a ship of my own.

sentences.ar: وقفنا عند جزيرة فيها بيضة رخ كبيرة.
sentences.en: We stopped at an island with a big roc’s egg.
The merchants with me broke the egg.

sentences.ar: قلت لهم لا، بس ما سمعوا مني.
sentences.en: I told them no, but they did not listen to me.
The roc came and saw its egg.

sentences.ar: طار فوقنا ورمى صخرة ضخمة عالسفينة.
sentences.en: It flew above us and dropped a huge rock on the ship.

sentences.ar: السفينة انكسرت وأنا طلعت عالشط لحالي.
sentences.en: The ship broke and I got to shore alone.
